summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing of Telugu POS billing app. All 7 pytest backend tests pass and all critical frontend flows work: shortcut code adding (b2, b1*3), quick items, qty/price edits with total recompute, discount, khata mode with customer, bill save+print (window.print overridden), Items page transliteration preview (venna->వెన్న), add item, edit price on blur, CSV import preview+apply, Khata settlement reducing balance, Report page (cash/UPI/card/khata cards and bills table), and mobile responsiveness at 390x844 on all 5 pages (no horizontal overflow).

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option>. Caused by emergent instrumentation runtime wrapping option text in a span (data-ve-dynamic). Not a functional issue and likely not fixable in user code, but noisy in console.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py list_bills date filter uses timezone-less string range while created_at is stored as tz-aware ISO (ends with +00:00). Current $lte comparison works for today (UTC) because it includes '+00:00' suffix on the upper bound but the lower bound f'{day}T00:00:00' is timezone-naive lexically — slight risk of edge cases around midnight/timezone. Reports currently correct for UTC same-day.
SEED_ITEMS 'created' counter in /api/seed is idempotent for items but customers are only seeded when collection is empty; documented behavior.
Billing.jsx window.print() called with 250ms setTimeout right after state resets — automation must override window.print (as we did) to avoid blocking.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests call /api/seed in an autouse session fixture; created a temporary bulk-import item 'test_bulk1' and deleted it after test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 7 tests, all pass). For frontend automation, ALWAYS add init script overriding window.print because Billing checkout and Report have print triggers. Toasts use sonner selectors [data-sonner-toast]. Bill numbers auto-increment so if this iteration created 3 bills, prior iterations affect totals; report totals include khata bill from this run (~1,092 cash historical + 566 khata). Customers list has 5 (seed 3 + likely 2 added in earlier runs).
